themes.label: Knowledge graphs
themes.meaning: Builds, designs or queries a knowledge graph (linked data, RDF, SPARQL) that connects entities across sources.

themes.label: Ontologies
themes.meaning: Creates, extends or maps ontology terms or controlled vocabularies (e.g. EDAM, ENVO, contributor roles) so things are annotated consistently.

themes.label: Data management
themes.meaning: Defines how research data is described, packaged, integrated or submitted (metadata standards, checklists, ISA/ARC packages, schemas) or guides how data is managed.

themes.label: Tools & workflows
themes.meaning: Registers, catalogues, assesses or ports software tools and computational workflows (bio.tools, WorkflowHub, Galaxy, Nextflow, CWL, Conda).

themes.label: Cloud & HPC
themes.meaning: Provides or connects the infrastructure analyses run on: cloud, HPC, federated job execution, containers or secure processing environments.

themes.label: Privacy & security
themes.meaning: Keeps sensitive data and the systems around it safe: privacy, secure processing environments, threat models, authentication.

themes.label: Generative AI
themes.meaning: Uses large language models or AI agents to do the work: generating or translating code and workflows, extracting information, filling forms or answering questions.

themes.label: Machine learning
themes.meaning: Trains or applies predictive models (neural networks, embeddings, classifiers, regression) to research data, or makes such models findable and runnable.

themes.label: Good practice
themes.meaning: Defines what good looks like and helps people get there: quality indicators, maturity scores, benchmarks, best-practice guidelines or handbooks.

themes.label: Visualisation
themes.meaning: Builds interactive visual views for exploring data: maps, network graphs, pathway diagrams, 3D structures, lifecycle wheels.

themes.label: Environment
themes.meaning: Works with environmental or ecological data: biodiversity, ecosystems, environmental and microbiome samples, exposures or climate.

themes.label: Credit & citations
themes.meaning: Tracks research outputs and the people behind them: publications, citations, author metrics, contributor roles, attribution, who does what.

themes.label: Genes & molecules
themes.meaning: Analyses molecular biology data directly: genomes, sequence alignments, protein structures, single-cell expression or metabolic pathways.
